nodes.label: Red-Yellow-Green delay state machine
nodes.rationale: Lightweight per-event color state machine (red -> yellow -> green); recurrence after green creates a NEW red event; red->green rejected because a mitigation plan is mandatory; event creation + downstream date cascade must be one transaction
